beacon_get_channel.name: beacon_get_channel
beacon_get_channel.description: Get details of a channel by integer ID.

beacon_get_iata.description: Get one MeshCore IATA area by its three-character code.

beacon_backfill_messages.description: Backfill channel messages strictly after a message ID; the array has no continuation cursor.

beacon_get_node_neighbors.name: beacon_get_node_neighbors

beacon_get_route_observations.name: beacon_get_route_observations

beacon_get_scope.name: beacon_get_scope

beacon_get_clock_drift.name: beacon_get_clock_drift

beacon_get_observation_stats.name: beacon_get_observation_stats
beacon_get_observation_stats.description: Get hourly observation counts per IATA.

beacon_get_path_stats.name: beacon_get_path_stats
beacon_get_path_stats.description: Get path distribution statistics for an explicit UTC window.

beacon_get_signal_stats.name: beacon_get_signal_stats
beacon_get_signal_stats.description: Get SNR/RSSI signal distributions for an explicit UTC window.

beacon_get_top_talkers.name: beacon_get_top_talkers
beacon_get_top_talkers.description: Rank companion names by public decrypted channel message count.
